source_record_bootstrap.sampling: With replacement within each domain; all methods and declared target conditions for a source remain paired within each draw.
source_record_bootstrap.frequency_strata: Resample source records, then sum correct and exposed-token numerators/denominators within each draw; do not average per-record stratum accuracies.
source_record_bootstrap.pooling: Domains, target conditions, and metric families remain separate; no pooled pass is reported.

benefit_routes.bound: q_alpha of the paired source-record bootstrap delta

harm_safeguards.bound: q_alpha of candidate-minus-control delta; require the lower bound to be >= the declared negative harm margin

gap_closure.bound: q_alpha of the source-record bootstrap closure fraction when the visibility rule is met

confidence_tails.descriptive_points: Report point deltas and denominators even when a bound or route is UNKNOWN.

exact_binary.unit: paired source-record exact outcome (all 127 post-BOS positions in each 128-token clip)

checkpoint_selection.metric: Equal-domain-weighted token accuracy: mean(Finance token accuracy, Pile token accuracy).
checkpoint_selection.rule: At execution replace N by the exact formula-derived integer, sort and deduplicate [0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 12000, N], choose the earliest checkpoint attaining the maximum metric, and break exact ties by earliest step. Do not use final-panel outcomes, LoRA validation, or posthoc grid changes.

contrast_rules.benefit_delta: candidate minus the named fixed comparator, paired per source record; report the percentile lower bound under the route alpha.
contrast_rules.harm_delta: candidate minus the named fixed comparator, paired per source record; report the one-sided lower q_0.05 bound and compare it with the negative harm margin.
contrast_rules.rare_missingness: Fewer than 32 exposed source records is UNKNOWN; zero exposed sources are NO_EXPOSURE/UNKNOWN and never a zero-harm result.
contrast_rules.ratio_denominator: For each remaining-error or gap-closure ratio route, if ANY bootstrap denominator is nonpositive, mark the WHOLE ratio interval UNKNOWN; never discard such draws opportunistically or treat them as zero.

exact_binary_bounds.unit: paired source-record exact outcome (all 127 post-BOS positions in each 128-token clip)

token_zero_variance.condition: The source-record bootstrap token delta has zero observed-difference variance.
token_zero_variance.decision: UNKNOWN for the route or safeguard under review.
token_zero_variance.interpretation: Do not treat a degenerate bootstrap interval as proof of no harm or adequate uncertainty.

statistical_procedure.route_separation: Token versus exact and directional versus data routes are separate predeclared questions. Each useful route uses alpha=0.025; no pooled family claim or post-score threshold substitution is allowed.

useful_outcome_proposal.fixed_control_selection: Directional route compares expanded_directional with both expanded_fixed (matched data) and current_fixed (second required current-coverage control); no posthoc fixed-arm winner or pre-data strength ranking.

token.ceiling_policy: If the relevant fixed accuracy leaves less than 0.5 percentage points of attainable headroom, report the absolute floor as ceiling-limited rather than as a failure; require the relative-error reduction, positive paired lower bound, and the predeclared A1+A2 anchor gap-closure evidence for a useful claim.

gap_closure.formula: closure_m = (M_candidate - M_unchanged_shared_start) / (M_A1_plus_A2 - M_unchanged_shared_start), computed on the common final panel per source-record bootstrap draw when the denominator is positive.
gap_closure.lower_bound_requirement: >= 0.25 on the same declared metric and anchor subset
gap_closure.unknown_rule: If any bootstrap denominator is nonpositive or the visibility floor is not met, mark the whole ratio route UNKNOWN; never discard nonpositive denominators opportunistically.
gap_closure.scope: Data and directional routes each report common-panel closure separately; no A1-only/A2-only decomposition.

useful_outcome_proposal.family_rule: Exact and token routes are separate predeclared routes, each route alpha 0.025; data and directional factor decisions are separate scientific questions with no pooled domains, target conditions, or metric families.
useful_outcome_proposal.interpretation: Useful result is mechanism evidence for this crossed study only. It does not automatically replace the reference, retrain, or expand the panel.
useful_outcome_proposal.control_requirement: Directional usefulness is reported separately from the data-scaling route. A flat directional contrast does not fail the study if expanded_fixed clears the predeclared data route.
useful_outcome_proposal.baseline: unchanged_shared_start (the shared TRR-0009 continued-fixed selected state)

directional_useful.contrast: expanded_directional versus expanded_fixed, with expanded_directional versus current_fixed as the required robustness comparison
directional_useful.success: Material absolute readout-direction route in both domains with all main-cell safeguards/cost gates; rare/absent strata are reported diagnostically.

data_useful.success: Material expanded-coverage route in both domains with baseline-to-A1+A2 anchor closure and all main-cell safeguards/cost gates; rare/absent strata are reported diagnostically; this route can succeed when directional interaction is flat.

combined_candidate.success: Report total improvement and interaction; do not replace the separate directional/data decisions.

useful_outcome_proposal.domain_rule: A route is study-useful only when its declared material absolute criterion and positive paired lower bound hold separately in both Finance and Pile. A one-domain result is reported as domain-specific evidence, not a global promotion.

harm_safeguards.confidence: One-sided lower q_0.05 bound for candidate-minus-control delta; require LCB >= the declared negative margin.

rare_absent.underpowered: UNKNOWN when fewer than 32 exposed source records; zero exposed sources are NO_EXPOSURE/UNKNOWN, never automatic PASS or zero-harm evidence.
rare_absent.route_role: Diagnostic-only. UNKNOWN rare/absent bins do not automatically veto a main useful route; if support reaches 32 sources, report the lower harm bound separately.

safeguards_and_cost.qualification: Qualify the largest expanded-directional cell and merged serialized adapter before the full matrix with fail-closed wall, disk, host-RSS, isolated-GPU-memory, and output-equivalence guards plus a measured free-memory margin; stop on allocator, driver, or output-equivalence anomalies. The current proposal is not execution-ready until the caps are jointly agreed.
safeguards_and_cost.streaming: Public activation generation and expanded-bank preparation are chunked; no unbounded resident corpus or artifact expansion.
safeguards_and_cost.deployed_artifact_accounting: An exported full readout W replaces the shared E file in deployed inference; do not charge E + W. Report the full training checkpoint, optimizer state, and preparation artifacts separately because they can be much larger.
safeguards_and_cost.memory_gate_unit: Gate memory using each method's isolated peak; pooled four-arm harness peaks are reported separately and are not deployment-memory gates.
safeguards_and_cost.candidate_to_a1_a2_cost_gate: Measure candidate_warmed_runtime / A1+A2_warmed_runtime on the common panel; PASS requires <=0.25 when the comparator is bound, otherwise UNKNOWN.

resource_caps.hard_guard: No unbounded run; stop before full matrix unless all four caps and fail-closed guards are jointly agreed from a representative largest-cell receipt.

public_development_validation.panel: Opened TRR-0009 matched public natural panel, proposed as TRR-0010 public development only.
public_development_validation.metric: Equal-domain-weighted natural token accuracy: mean(Finance token accuracy, Pile token accuracy); target conditions remain paired within source.
public_development_validation.checkpoint_rule: Earliest maximum at the declared checkpoint interval; no final truth is opened for this selection.
public_development_validation.bank_exclusion: Validation records and derived rows are excluded from both fitting banks and the final natural panel.
public_development_validation.fit_vs_validation_geometry: Fit context width 192; natural validation clip width 128 with 127 scored post-BOS positions.
public_development_validation.selection_scope: Selection validation is exactly the 384 matched-public observations: 256 Finance + 128 Pile, public_base only. The LoRA target is not used for checkpoint selection.
public_development_validation.secondary: The inherited 48-record style-balanced panel is secondary diagnostic context only, not checkpoint-selection evidence.

training_geometry_and_schedule.geometry_gate: Verified full width-192 fit geometry and separate width-128 natural-validation geometry; no crop substitution.
training_geometry_and_schedule.exact_update_count_freeze: Freeze the exact integer N from the deterministic formula before fitting; do not choose it from final outcomes.
training_geometry_and_schedule.schedule: Cosine decay, AdamW, base learning rate 2e-4, weight_decay=0, gradient_clip_norm=1.0, seed 4010; no staging schedule, teacher ranking, search, or A2 fallback.
training_geometry_and_schedule.expanded_bank_coverage_reason: Compute actual_B1_valid_positions from the bound expanded bank. The formula targets at least five valid-position exposures and rounds N upward in common 1,000-update increments.
training_geometry_and_schedule.validation_selection: Earliest maximum of a predeclared domain-balanced public token-accuracy score on the exact sorted-unique checkpoint grid [0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 12000, N]; ties choose earliest.
training_geometry_and_schedule.source_interface: Fit rows and natural-validation clips use separately declared context widths; fitting uses verified all-valid geometry and final clips retain 127 post-BOS positions.

expanded_position_exposure_requirement.freeze_rule: Compute actual_B1_valid_positions from the bound expanded bank; if formula-derived N exceeds 20,000, stop for contract revision.

training_geometry_and_schedule.checkpoint_grid_rule: At execution replace symbolic N by its exact integer, sort and deduplicate the grid, and evaluate no other checkpoints.
training_geometry_and_schedule.recommended_schedule_receipt: A2 fixed-control review proposed 12,000 updates; v4 replaces that provisional count with the deterministic N formula.

exact_update_count_formula.cap_rule: If computed N exceeds 20,000, stop and request contract revision before any fit; never silently cap or reduce exposure.
exact_update_count_formula.common_arm_rule: Use the same exact integer N for all four arms.

verified_geometry.statement: The fit mask is full width-192 geometry; width-128 is only the natural-evaluation clip.

directional_readout_constants.regularization: lambda * mean_v[(1 + 4/sqrt(count_v)) * ||Delta[v]||_2^2 / (H * rms(E[v])^2 + eps)] with lambda=1e-4; frequency-weighted relative L2 to E.
directional_readout_constants.parameterization: E_eff[v] = E[v] + Delta[v] for v in supported fitting rows S; E_eff[v] = E[v] outside S. Delta[S] is a full independent [|S|, 2048] FP32 row table.
directional_readout_constants.support_definition: S is every vocabulary row with positive fitting-bank count; absent rows have no adapter parameters and remain the base readout.
directional_readout_constants.deployment: Merged full readout W is the required training-qualification and inference path; no special validation hook is assumed. Any sparse supported-column implementation is diagnostic-only for output-equivalence checks and cannot be used as a fit, validation, or deployment fallback. W replaces E in deployed storage.
directional_readout_constants.row_constraints: No hard gain/bias bound and no row renormalization. Unsupported rows have no adapter parameter and remain E exactly.

inventory_known_exclusion_chain.interpretation: TRR7 ledgers cover prior fit/dev/opened public identities; TRR8 selection adds 1,024 Finance and 384 Pile source identities; P07 reports no new identities and reuses already-opened panels.

namespace_canonicalization.rule: Do not compare rendered, public-record, final-sequence, reservation, source-ID, or row-index digests across namespaces; use each receipt canonicalization exactly.
